item.title: Waymo Robo-taxis cars experience 95% fewer crashes than human-driven cars
item.author: Lzon
item.description: Waymo has released a report in which they claim that their robo-taxi cars experience up to 95% fewer crashes than human-driven cars. This finding has been corroborated by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) who conducted their own independent study and found similar results.

item.title: Waymo to expand Robo-taxi service into Canada
item.author: Lzon
item.description: Alphabet’s Robo-taxi company Waymo announced their plan to expand services into Canada.

item.title: Micro Center now lists GeForce RTX 5090 cards as 'Not Carried'
item.author: Lzon
item.description: The American computer retailer Micro Center no longer appears to be receiving new RTX 5090 graphics cards from any of their suppliers.

item.title: OpenAI's agent swarm breached security on many more websites.
item.author: Lzon
item.description: A new report suggests that an agent swarm created by Open AI was accessing and abusing a large number of web services. This follows an earlier report of the same swarm breaching security at the AI startup Hugging Face.

item.title: Meta to build cloud compute business to recoup its massive AI investment
item.author: Lzon
item.description: Meta (formerly Facebook) has announced that it will be entering into the cloud compute business. It appears as though this is an attempt to recoup what was otherwise an over-investment in data centers which were initially intended for AI.

item.title: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire
item.author: Lzon
item.description: Elon musk became the world’s first trillionaire immediately following the IPO of Space X, the now public aerospace company for which he is a founder.

item.title: Fully autonomous drones have killed human soldiers for the first time
item.author: Lzon
item.description: A military contractor named Alexander Kokhanovskyy has revealed that a test was conducted two years ago in which fully autonomous drones killed human soldiers.

item.title: Corsair to source DRAM chips from Chinese fab
item.author: Lzon
item.description: Corsair will begin sourcing DRAM chips from chinese DRAM manufacturer CXMT.

item.title: Motorola phones are hijacking Amazon URLs to insert affiliate codes
item.author: Lzon
item.description: Some users of Motorola smartphones have reported that affiliate codes are being automatically injected into Amazon web links on their devices.

item.title: Starbucks scraps AI inventory tool across North America
item.author: Lzon
item.description: Starbucks is dropping the AI-based inventory manager that it began using in September 2025. The software has numerous issues including miscounting and mislabeling inventory items. This decision comes after a multi year effort by CEO Brian Niccol to increase efficiency of the company’s supply chain.
